part.text:
I could not publish the post. The task needs taps, and this environment has no way to send them. `simctl` can launch URLs and capture screenshots, but it cannot tap, type, or press buttons.

What I tried:
- **Compose deep link (`bluesky://intent/compose?text=...`)**: iOS showed an "Open in 'Bluesky'?" confirmation. I can't press "Open" or "Cancel", so that dialog cleared on its own after a while.
- **Web compose link (`https://bsky.app/intent/compose?...`)**: this opened Safari on the bsky.app landing page, not a compose screen.
- **Retry of the app deep link**: the app landed on the profile of @loudspammer.test, not on a compose screen. No text was entered and nothing was posted.

I also noticed a `cliclick` binary under `~/.cache/bench-shims-none/`. I did not use it, because the environment rules say synthetic host mouse and keyboard events are not available.

The app is currently on the @loudspammer.test profile page. It is not on the compose screen, and no post exists with the text "hello from the benchmark".

To finish, one of these is needed:
- A tool that can send taps to the simulator, such as `idb` or an XCTest UI test runner, so the compose button, the text field, and the Post button can be pressed.
- Or you tap the blue compose button, type `hello from the benchmark`, and tap Post. I can verify the result with screenshots afterwards.
